items.quote: 22:1 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 22:2 Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.
items.claim: The LORD commanded that Aaron and his sons separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel and not profane the divine name
items.actor: the LORD; Aaron and his sons
items.action: spake; commanded to separate and not profane
items.object: holy things of the children of Israel; holy name
